```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 6)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = here::here())
```

Figure 1 (study design, one example trajectory with the REML spline, its uncertainty and the
limit of detection, number of variants per individual, variants by gene and type) and Figure S1 (all 71 trajectories,
one panel each, with the limit of detection of every timepoint). The trajectories are the final set
(longitudinal assay only, per-timepoint LoD, not detected timepoints at LoD / 2; `resources/chip_calls_long_filtered.txt`),
the curves the REML splines of `resources/LoD/`. Participant ids are the new ids of the paper.

```{r libraries}
source("R/paper_functions.R")
library(gratia)
library(png)
library(grid)

calls <- load_calls()
pred  <- load_pred()
pred2 <- load_pred2()
sum_  <- load_sum()
ages  <- load_ages()
ids   <- load_ids()
n_draws <- 1000
```

# 1. Numbers for the text

```{r numbers}
numbers <- tibble(
  individuals = n_distinct(calls$ID), trajectories = n_distinct(calls$traj_id), measurements = nrow(calls),
  `Mutect2 calls` = sum(calls$source == "original"), `pile-up rescues` = sum(calls$source == "bam_readcount"),
  `not detected (LoD/2)` = sum(calls$source == "imputed"),
  `median depth (IQR)` = iqr_txt(calls$lod_depth, 0),   # all 374 measurements, as in Table S10
  `median LoD, % VAF (IQR)` = iqr_txt(100 * calls$lod_vaf, 2),
  `max LoD, % VAF` = sprintf("%.2f", 100 * max(calls$lod_vaf)),
  `timepoints per trajectory, median (IQR)` = iqr_txt(count(calls, traj_id)$n, 0),
  `first age, median (IQR)` = iqr_txt((calls %>% group_by(ID) %>% summarise(a = min(Age)))$a, 1),
  `follow-up per individual, years, median (IQR)` = iqr_txt((calls %>% group_by(ID) %>% summarise(a = max(Age) - min(Age)))$a, 1))
knitr::kable(t(numbers))
write_res(as.data.frame(t(numbers)) %>% rownames_to_column("item") %>% setNames(c("item", "value")), "figure1_numbers.txt")

ind <- calls %>% distinct(ID, N_CHIP)
knitr::kable(ind %>% count(N_CHIP) %>% mutate(share = sprintf("%.0f%%", 100 * n / sum(n))), caption = "Variants per individual")
genes <- calls %>% distinct(traj_id, Gene = group_genes(Gene.refGene), ExonicFunc.refGene)
knitr::kable(genes %>% count(Gene) %>% mutate(share = sprintf("%.0f%%", 100 * n / sum(n))), caption = "Trajectories by gene")
knitr::kable(genes %>% count(ExonicFunc.refGene) %>% arrange(-n) %>% mutate(share = sprintf("%.0f%%", 100 * n / sum(n))), caption = "Trajectories by type")
```

# 2. Figure 1b: one trajectory with the REML spline, its uncertainty and the LoD

The panel shows a hypothetical trajectory of five measurements, fitted with the REML spline of the main analysis, with
the LoD of the trajectory (the mean LoD of its timepoints, as in the main analysis) and the extrapolation back to LoD/2. The band around the curve is the 95% interval of the REML fit; speed and
acceleration (orange, red) are the finite differences of the curve over half a year, with 95% intervals from
`r n_draws` draws of the spline coefficients.

```{r fig1b, fig.width=7, fig.height=5}
# A hypothetical trajectory, fitted with the REML spline of the main analysis
obs <- tibble(Age = c(55, 60, 65, 70, 75), AF = c(0.06, 0.10, 0.08, 0.12, 0.20), lod_vaf = 0.003)
fit <- fit_traj(obs$Age, obs$AF, spec_main)
traj_lod <- mean(obs$lod_vaf)   # the LoD of the trajectory: the mean LoD of its timepoints
lod2 <- traj_lod / 2
grid_age <- seq(min(obs$Age), max(obs$Age), by = 0.1)
fs <- fitted_samples(fit$model, n = n_draws, data = data.frame(Age = c(grid_age, grid_age + step)), seed = 1) %>% arrange(.draw, .row)
n <- length(grid_age)
m <- matrix(fs$.fitted, nrow = 2 * n)
vaf_d <- pmax(m[1:n, , drop = FALSE], lod2)
speed_d <- (m[(n + 1):(2 * n), , drop = FALSE] - m[1:n, , drop = FALSE]) / step
acc_d <- (speed_d - rbind(speed_d[1, , drop = FALSE], speed_d[-n, , drop = FALSE])) / step   # backward difference of the speed
acc_d[1, ] <- NA
band <- function(x, name) tibble(Age = grid_age, curve = name, mean = rowMeans(x), lo = apply(x, 1, quantile, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE), hi = apply(x, 1, quantile, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE))
curve_main <- tibble(Age = grid_age, VAF = pmax(fit$predict(grid_age), lod2))
bands <- bind_rows(band(vaf_d, "VAF"), band(speed_d, "VAF speed"), band(acc_d, "VAF acceleration"))
# summary statistics on the half-year grid, as in the main analysis
g05 <- seq(min(obs$Age), max(obs$Age), by = 0.5)
v05 <- pmax(fit$predict(g05), lod2); s05 <- diff(v05) / 0.5; a05 <- diff(s05) / 0.5
stats <- list(max_VAF_speed = max(s05), mean_VAF_speed = mean(s05), min_VAF_speed = min(s05), sd_VAF_speed = sd(s05),
              max_VAF_acceleration = max(a05), mean_VAF_acceleration = mean(a05), min_VAF_acceleration = min(a05), sd_VAF_acceleration = sd(a05))
# extrapolation back in time to LoD/2 and the two threshold ages
ext_age <- seq(min(obs$Age) - 30, min(obs$Age), by = 0.1)
extrap <- tibble(Age = ext_age, VAF = fit$predict(ext_age)) %>% filter(VAF >= lod2)
all_curve <- bind_rows(extrap, curve_main) %>% arrange(Age)
age2 <- list(Age_LoD2 = min(extrap$Age), Age_0.02 = all_curve$Age[which(all_curve$VAF >= chip_vaf)[1]])

sec <- max(curve_main$VAF) / max(abs(c(bands$lo[bands$curve != "VAF"], bands$hi[bands$curve != "VAF"])), na.rm = TRUE)
deriv_colors <- c("VAF speed" = "#E69F00", "VAF acceleration" = "#B2182B")
lab_txt <- sprintf("max = %.4f\nmean = %.4f\nmin = %.4f\nSD = %.4f", c(stats$max_VAF_speed, stats$max_VAF_acceleration), c(stats$mean_VAF_speed, stats$mean_VAF_acceleration),
                   c(stats$min_VAF_speed, stats$min_VAF_acceleration), c(stats$sd_VAF_speed, stats$sd_VAF_acceleration))
x_min <- min(c(extrap$Age, obs$Age)) - 1
p_1b <- ggplot() +
  geom_ribbon(data = filter(bands, curve == "VAF"), aes(x = Age, ymin = lo, ymax = hi), fill = "grey75", alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_ribbon(data = filter(bands, curve != "VAF"), aes(x = Age, ymin = lo * sec, ymax = hi * sec, fill = curve), alpha = 0.18) +
  geom_line(data = extrap, aes(x = Age, y = VAF), colour = "grey40", linewidth = 1.2, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_line(data = curve_main, aes(x = Age, y = VAF), colour = "grey35", linewidth = 1.6) +
  geom_line(data = filter(bands, curve != "VAF"), aes(x = Age, y = mean * sec, colour = curve), linewidth = 1.3) +
  geom_hline(data = tibble(y = traj_lod), aes(yintercept = y, linetype = "LoD of the trajectory"), colour = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = chip_vaf, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_point(data = obs, aes(x = Age, y = AF), size = 3, colour = "black") +
  annotate("point", x = age2$Age_0.02, y = chip_vaf, shape = 23, size = 3.8, fill = "white", colour = "grey20") +
  annotate("text", x = age2$Age_0.02, y = chip_vaf, label = "age at 2% VAF", vjust = -1.1, hjust = 0.1, size = 3.8) +
  annotate("point", x = age2$Age_LoD2, y = lod2, shape = 23, size = 3.8, fill = "white", colour = "grey20") +
  annotate("text", x = age2$Age_LoD2, y = lod2, label = "age at LoD/2 (detectable onset)", vjust = 1.8, hjust = 0.1, size = 3.8) +
  annotate("text", x = x_min, y = max(curve_main$VAF) * 1.0, label = lab_txt[1], colour = deriv_colors[1], hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 4) +
  annotate("text", x = x_min + 0.3 * (max(obs$Age) - x_min), y = max(curve_main$VAF) * 1.0, label = lab_txt[2], colour = deriv_colors[2], hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 4) +
  scale_y_continuous(name = "VAF", sec.axis = sec_axis(~ . / sec, name = "VAF speed | acceleration"), expand = expansion(mult = c(0.03, 0.08))) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = deriv_colors, name = NULL, guide = guide_legend(order = 2)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = deriv_colors, guide = "none") +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("LoD of the trajectory" = "dotted"), name = NULL, guide = guide_legend(order = 1)) +
  labs(x = "Age") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 15) +
  theme(axis.title.y.right = element_text(colour = "#E69F00"), axis.text.y.right = element_text(colour = "#E69F00"),
        legend.position = "bottom", legend.box = "vertical", legend.spacing.y = unit(0, "pt"), legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 11))
p_1b
save_panel(p_1b, 1, "Fig1b_hypothetical_trajectory_REML", 7, 5.5)
```

# 3. Figure 1c and 1d: variants per individual, variants by gene and type

```{r fig1cd, fig.width=11, fig.height=4}
mut_levels <- c("splicing", "frameshift insertion", "frameshift deletion", "stopgain", "nonsynonymous SNV")
traj_variants <- calls %>%
  filter(!is.na(ExonicFunc.refGene)) %>%
  distinct(ID, Gene.refGene, traj_id, ExonicFunc.refGene) %>%
  mutate(Gene.refGene = ifelse(Gene.refGene %in% other_genes, "Other", Gene.refGene),
         Gene.refGene = factor(Gene.refGene, levels = c("DNMT3A", "TET2", "ASXL1", "TP53", "PPM1D", "Other")),
         type = recode(ExonicFunc.refGene, "nonsynonymous SNV" = "missense", "stopgain" = "nonsense"),
         type = factor(type, levels = c("splicing", "frameshift insertion", "frameshift deletion", "nonsense", "missense")))
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(traj_variants$traj_id), all(traj_variants$ExonicFunc.refGene %in% mut_levels))
count_axis <- function(N) {
  top <- max(30, 5 * ceiling(max(N) / 5))
  scale_y_continuous(name = "Count", breaks = seq(0, top, 5), limits = c(0, top))
}
gene_mut_counts <- traj_variants %>% count(Gene.refGene, type, name = "N")
p_1d <- ggplot(gene_mut_counts, aes(x = Gene.refGene, y = N, fill = type, label = N)) +
  geom_col(color = "black") +
  count_axis(traj_variants %>% count(Gene.refGene) %>% pull(n)) +
  xlab("") +
  geom_text(size = 3.5, position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5)) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 17, angle = 45, hjust = 1, face = "italic"), axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 17)) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(title = "Mutation type"))
p_1c <- calls %>% distinct(ID, N_CHIP) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = N_CHIP)) +
  geom_bar(color = "black", fill = "grey", linewidth = 0.8) +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_y_continuous(name = "Count", breaks = seq(0, 40, 10), limits = c(0, 40)) +
  xlab("Number of CHIP variants per individual") +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 17), axis.title = element_text(size = 16))
save_panel(p_1c, 1, "Fig1c_num_chip", 5, 4)
save_panel(p_1d, 1, "Fig1d_gene_mut_distr", 6, 4)
p_1c | p_1d
```

# 4. Figure 1 assembled

Panel a is the drawn study scheme (`assets/Study_scheme.png`).

```{r fig1, fig.width=13, fig.height=13}
scheme <- readPNG("assets/Study_scheme.png")
# crop the white margins of the scheme
ink <- if (dim(scheme)[3] == 4) scheme[, , 4] > 0.05 else (scheme[, , 1] < 0.97 | scheme[, , 2] < 0.97 | scheme[, , 3] < 0.97)
rows <- range(which(rowMeans(ink) > 0.002)); cols <- range(which(colMeans(ink) > 0.002))   # stray pixels are ignored
scheme <- scheme[rows[1]:rows[2], cols[1]:cols[2], ]
cat("scheme aspect (width / height):", ncol(scheme) / nrow(scheme), "\n")
p_1a <- wrap_elements(full = rasterGrob(scheme, interpolate = TRUE))   # fits the cell, keeps the aspect ratio
layout <- "
AAAAAA
AAAAAA
BBBBCC
BBBBCC
BBBBDD
BBBBDD
"
# c over d as one block, so that the tall gene labels of d do not stretch the axis-title row of b
right <- wrap_elements(full = (p_1c / p_1d) + plot_annotation(tag_levels = list(c("c", "d"))) & tag_theme)
bottom <- ((p_1b + theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.box = "horizontal")) | right) + plot_layout(widths = c(1.1, 1))
p_1 <- (p_1a / bottom) + plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1.45)) + plot_annotation(tag_levels = list(c("a", "b", ""))) & tag_theme
save_main(p_1, 1, "Figure1", 13, 11.5, svg = TRUE)
p_1
```

# 5. Figure S1: all trajectories with the limit of detection

One panel per trajectory (new participant id, gene and protein change), ordered by participant. Points: measured VAF
(filled circle: Mutect2 call; triangle: variant reads in the read pile-up at a timepoint without a call; open circle:
no variant read, set to half the LoD of the timepoint). Dotted black line: the LoD of each timepoint, from its depth at
the variant. Coloured line: the REML spline (floored at half the trajectory's mean LoD). Dashed line: 2% VAF. Log scale.

```{r figS1, fig.width=16, fig.height=19}
panel_levels <- calls %>% distinct(SHCS_ID_new, traj_id, label, Gene.refGene) %>%
  mutate(num = as.integer(sub("SHCS_", "", SHCS_ID_new)), panel = paste(SHCS_ID_new, label)) %>%
  arrange(num, Gene.refGene, label) %>% pull(panel)
obs_s1 <- calls %>% mutate(panel = factor(paste(SHCS_ID_new, label), levels = panel_levels), Gene = group_genes(Gene.refGene))
curve_s1 <- pred %>% inner_join(calls %>% distinct(traj_id, label), by = "traj_id") %>%
  mutate(panel = factor(paste(SHCS_ID_new, label), levels = panel_levels), Gene = group_genes(Gene.refGene))
p_s1 <- ggplot() +
  geom_line(data = curve_s1, aes(x = Age, y = VAF, colour = Gene), linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_line(data = obs_s1, aes(x = Age, y = lod_vaf, linetype = "LoD of the timepoint"), colour = "black", linewidth = 0.45) +
  geom_point(data = obs_s1, aes(x = Age, y = AF, colour = Gene, shape = source), size = 1.8) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = chip_vaf, linewidth = 0.4, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_y_log10(breaks = c(0.001, 0.01, 0.1), labels = c("0.1%", "1%", "10%"), limits = c(5e-4, 0.55)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = gene_colors, name = "CHIP gene", guide = guide_legend(order = 3)) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = source_shapes, labels = source_labels, name = NULL, guide = guide_legend(order = 2)) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("LoD of the timepoint" = "dotted"), name = NULL, guide = guide_legend(order = 1)) +
  facet_wrap(~panel, ncol = 8, scales = "free_x") +
  labs(x = "Age", y = "VAF") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 8.5), strip.background = element_blank(), legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.text = element_text(size = 11))
save_supp(p_s1, "FigS1_all_trajectories_LoD", 16, 19)
p_s1
```
